paragraphs.text: Entry to the permanent galleries is free. The exhibition on the first floor costs £8, or £6 for students and visitors over 65. Under-12s go free to everything if accompanied by an adult.

Bags larger than a rucksack must be left in the cloakroom, which closes fifteen minutes before the museum. Photography without flash is allowed except in the exhibition. The café closes an hour before the galleries.

items.prompt: There is no charge for the permanent galleries.
A student pays £8 for the exhibition.
Photography is permitted in the exhibition.
The café is open later than the galleries.
